name: Army Painter
author: crystal-mods
description: Recolor your army's paint scheme in-game. A BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) plugin recolors the local player's units (primary + secondary colours, e.g. Blood Angels red -> Ultramarines blue) with a hotkey-toggled color-changing UI. Per-faction colour schemes persist in the BepInEx config. Uses MaterialPropertyBlock + cached albedo remap: no game asset is ever modified and the whole paint job is reversible with one click. Also works on unit previews.

features.ui: In-game IMGUI window (F10 hotkey or on-screen button) with faction presets, RGB sliders, hex input, live tint preview, Apply and Reset.
features.recolor: Auto-detects the two dominant paint colours of each unit texture and remaps them toward the chosen colours, preserving baked shading and leaving metal/grime untouched.
features.persistence: Per-faction primary/secondary colours saved to BepInEx/config/com.crystalmods.armypainter.cfg; new units are auto-repainted.
features.scope: Local player's whole army (ContestantType.LocalPlayer units); falls back to all visible models in army-builder / preview scenes.

compatibility.note: Runtime plugin (BepInEx/plugins/ArmyPainter.dll only). It modifies no asset bundle and no shared game material, so it has NO file conflicts.
compatibility.bepinex-framework: Required — provides the BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) runtime this plugin loads under.
compatibility.red-laser-lasgun: Compatible. That plugin draws its own beam renderers/materials; this only sets MaterialPropertyBlocks on unit albedos.
compatibility.tc-localization: Compatible. Coexists with TCFix.dll in BepInEx/plugins/.
compatibility.the-great-crusade: Compatible. That mod edits data bundles; this adds only a plugin DLL.

config: BepInEx/config/com.crystalmods.armypainter.cfg — ToggleKey, ShowButton, AutoApply, HueWindow, SatThreshold, BlendFeather, DiagMode, and per-faction Primary/Secondary hex colours.
